verified_facts.text: Santa Marina sits on the private peninsula of Ornos Bay with its own sandy beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled on the private peninsula of Ornos Bay, with its own sandy beach and endless views of a sun-drenched horizon

verified_facts.text: The resort is designed like a traditional Mykonian village on a slope leading down to the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed like a traditional Mykonian village perched on a slope leading down to the sea

verified_facts.text: The private beach is a curve of golden sand in a quiet cove that slopes gradually into clear, shallow water.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled in a quiet cove this curve of golden sand slopes gradually into crystal-clear, shallow waters.

verified_facts.text: Santa Marina has its own private stretch of sandy beach on Ornos Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Santa Marina is the only resort on Mykonos island with its own private stretch of sandy beach

verified_facts.text: Ornos Bay is largely shielded from the strong Cycladic winds.
verified_facts.excerpt: on calm and sought-after Ornos Bay, where you’re largely shielded from the almighty Cycladic winds

verified_facts.text: The property is still owned by the local family that opened it.
verified_facts.excerpt: The five-star property remains owned by the same local family that opened it four decades ago.

verified_facts.text: The grounds still have the original windmill and a whitewashed chapel.
verified_facts.excerpt: which still has its original windmill and whitewashed chapel

verified_facts.text: Interiors are by Greek interior designer Silvina Macipe Krontiras, with light tones and natural island accents of wood and raffia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Greek interior designer Silvina Macipe Krontiras. Interiors feature light tones with natural island accents of wood and raffia

verified_facts.text: Suites have sea views from a balcony or terrace furnished with outdoor dining and sun loungers.
verified_facts.excerpt: All feature seamless sea views from the balcony or terrace, furnished with outdoor dining for two and sunlounges.

verified_facts.text: The resort's villas each include a fully equipped kitchen, a swimming pool and butler service.
verified_facts.excerpt: all include a fully equipped kitchen, swimming pool and butler service

verified_facts.text: The Oasis Pool is a seawater infinity pool with private cabanas set in the water.
verified_facts.excerpt: This unique seawater pool features four private cabanas that appear immersed in the water.

verified_facts.text: The Oasis Pool is exclusively for adults.
verified_facts.excerpt: Exclusively for adults, the Oasis Pool embodies Santa Marina’s innately glamorous lifestyle.

verified_facts.text: The infinity-edge Elais Pool has a nearby heated whirlpool and is suited to children.
verified_facts.excerpt: the infinity-edge Elais Pool is expansive in size and features a nearby heated whirlpool. This pool is ideal for children

verified_facts.text: Ginkgo Spa treatments use natural skincare and thalassotherapy from ESPA and 111SKIN.
verified_facts.excerpt: Treatments exclusively feature natural skincare and thalassotherapy from two renowned spa brands, ESPA and 111SKIN.

verified_facts.text: Ginkgo Spa has a traditional hammam, a sauna and a relaxation area.
verified_facts.excerpt: as well as a traditional Hammam, a sauna, relaxation area and locker rooms for men and women.

verified_facts.text: Santa Marina is home to the world's first Buddha-Bar Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: including a cocktail bar and the world’s first ever Buddha-Bar Beach

verified_facts.text: Elais serves Greek cuisine with Mediterranean influences.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elais by Santa Marina Mykonos, celebrates a Greek cuisine homecoming with Mediterranean influences.

verified_facts.text: The beach club stretches from the beachfront onto a boardwalk jetty into the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: The heart of it all is the beach club, which stretches from the beachfront onto a boardwalk jetty that juts perpendicular into the ocean

verified_facts.text: The resort offers speedboats by the hour for exploring beaches and nearby islands.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our rubber speedboats, available for an hourly rate, are ideal for exploring the beautiful beaches or nearby islands in comfort.

verified_facts.text: Reef Boutique, right on the private beach, sells fashion, jewellery and beachwear.
verified_facts.excerpt: Right on our private beach, Reef Boutique reflects the super-chic style of Mykonos with a selection of fashion-forward clothes, jewellery, sunglasses and accessories for women and men.

verified_facts.text: Guests can arrange a private dinner by the sea created by the Executive Chef.
verified_facts.excerpt: Make it a day to remember with a private dinner by the sea created by our Executive Chef.

verified_facts.text: A shaded, sea-view playground is designed for children ages three and older.
verified_facts.excerpt: we have a specially designed playground for children ages three and older. Shaded from the sun, this sea-view facility

verified_facts.text: Mykonos town is about a 15-minute car ride from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beyond the resort, Mykonos town is a 15-minute car ride away

verified_facts.text: There are elevators and ramps to most areas, but the hillside grounds still have many stairs and hills.
verified_facts.excerpt: There are elevators and ramps to most areas and guest rooms, but still many stairs and hills to navigate.

verified_facts.text: The beachfront restaurant becomes a lively bar at night, so rooms near the spa are quieter.
verified_facts.excerpt: request a room near the spa and away from the beachfront restaurant, which becomes a thrumming bar at night

verified_facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

verified_facts.text: Santa Marina is pet-friendly for pets up to 10 kilograms.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are a pet-friendly hotel and accommodate pets weighing up to 10kgs.

verified_facts.text: Accommodations were fully renovated in 2017.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fully renovated in 2017, the accommodations feature an organic, modern style
